sloka: ततो राममभिक्रम्य सौमित्रिरभिवाद्य च।तस्थौ भ्रातृसमीपस्थ इन्द्रस्येव बृहस्पतिः ।। ६.९२.४ ।।
transliteration: tato rāmamabhikramya saumitrirabhivādya ca।tasthau bhrātṛsamīpastha indrasyeva bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 6.92.4 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Saumithri went close to Rama and offered prayers, like Indra's brother Upendra and stood close to his brother.
translations.hindi: वह बलो रावशतनथ इन्द्रजीत यहीं पर पशुओं का बलिदान करके, पीछे लड़ने को जाता हे
